item.title: Trial dates pushed ahead for 3 suspects in Tippecanoe County judge’s shooting
item.description: Three suspects accused of conspiring to kill a Tippecanoe County judge have had their trial dates pushed to the summer, as the defendants' attorneys await evidence from the state, while the defense for another of the suspects has requested a new special prosecutor.

item.title: Feeling like late May with record highs possible, rain and storm chances | March 5, 2026
item.description: Indiana is expecting a warm and humid end to the workweek with potential record high temperatures and scattered showers, while Saturday will bring more rain and storm chances with a Level 1-of-5 risk for isolated strong-to-severe storms.

item.title: Athlete of the week: Carmel’s Evan Harrell
item.description: Carmel boys basketball, led by senior forward Evan Harrell, is looking to win its first state championship in five seasons, as they tip off their postseason on Friday against Noblesville.

item.title: Police apprehend 6 juveniles for reckless e-bike riding in McCordsville
item.description: Six juveniles were taken into custody in McCordsville, Indiana, after a police officer watched them ride electric bikes recklessly through rush-hour traffic, disregarding traffic signals and performing wheelies while traveling at 40 mph.

item.title: Bond set at $1M for 2nd teen charged in Shelby County school shooting plot
item.description: Melanie Little, 17, of Corinth, Mississippi, was charged with attempted murder and conspiracy to commit murder for a planned Columbine-style mass shooting at Morristown Junior-Senior High School, and her bond was set at $1 million.

item.title: Report: Colts exploring possible trade of Zaire Franklin
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts are reportedly speaking with teams about a trade involving linebacker Zaire Franklin.

item.title: US hits Iranian drone carrier; intense Israeli airstrikes pound Tehran, Beirut
item.description: Israel and the U.S. have intensified their campaign in the Middle East, with Israel launching a broad-scale wave of airstrikes on Tehran and the U.S. striking an Iranian drone carrier at sea. Iran has responded with missile and drone attacks into Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Bahrain.

item.title: 18-year-old man arrested after 18-year-old Seymour woman shot in Columbus
item.description: Skyler Vera, 18, of Columbus, Indiana, was arrested in connection to a Wednesday afternoon shooting of an 18-year-old woman in a housing addition in the Bartholomew County city. Police say he faces a preliminary charge of aggravated battery with a deadly weapon.

item.title: Judge blocks Indiana abortion ban for women with religious objections
item.description: A Marion County superior court judge granted a permanent injunction preventing Indiana from enforcing its near-total abortion ban against women whose religious beliefs necessitate the procedure. Judge Christina R. Klineman ruled that the 2022 abortion law violates the state's 2015 religious freedom restoration law.

item.title: Center Grove senior charged with child molestation, solicitation
item.description: Samuel Erh, an 18-year-old Center Grove High School senior, has been charged with multiple counts of child molestation, solicitation, and more after a child reported being sexually abused by him and detectives found almost 1,000 files showing pre-pubescent and pubescent children involved in sexual acts.
